audit.why: FAV 4/10 fits 55.35% over 963 games, and for the right reason: Broken Wings and Valor are both dashes, so Steadfast Presence genuinely turns off her whole engage and escape.
audit.corrected: Difficulty and carry threat unchanged — this is one of the few pages where the W dash-stop claim is true.

audit.whatIsWrong: Chart read Poppy, Poppy, Poppy, Poppy, Skill, Poppy, Poppy in both layers; the packet has Skill, Poppy, Poppy, Poppy, Poppy, Poppy, Riven.
audit.why: whys[0] says 'you're both weak at Level 1' on a Poppy row, and whys[6] says outright 'Riven out-scales you' on a Poppy row — the 2+ item row is hers, and the page's own spike agrees.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 4 and 6 flipped as one atomic paired group in both layers to Skill, Poppy, Poppy, Poppy, Poppy, Poppy, Riven. Ratings to 5/7/7/7/6/6/3.

audit.whatIsWrong: The dash-denial is right but has no numbers, and one interaction is missing entirely: Ki Burst (W, 11/10/9/8/7s) is a point-blank stun that cancels Keeper's Verdict, which is a channel.
audit.why: Poppy's 140s ultimate is the page's stated win condition, and the one ability that deletes it goes unnamed. Concrete cooldowns also make the W-hold advice usable: Broken Wings is a flat 13s, Valor 10-6s.
audit.corrected: Real cooldowns added to the hold-W advice, and the Ki Burst channel cancel written into the level-6 row and the don'ts.

audit.why: The existing advice not to spend W on her first Q dash, and to hold it for the full Q-Q-Q commit so the escape is blocked too, is the correct read and is already stated well.

edits.before: Riven lives and dies by her dashes, and your W (Steadfast Presence) turns all three Q dashes plus her E off the moment you activate it — that's the whole lane. At Level 1 you're both weak, so just farm. At 2-3 once you have Q and E, hold W until she commits her Q-Q-Q-E combo, ground her, then E her into the wall behind you for the stun and Q her max-HP. Don't waste W on her first Q dash — wait for the full engage so you block the escape too.
edits.after: Riven lives and dies by her dashes, and Steadfast Presence stops all three Broken Wings casts plus Valor the moment you activate it — that is the whole lane. At Level 1 you are both weak, so just farm. From 2-3, hold W until she commits the Q-Q-Q-E combo, ground her, then E her into the wall behind you and Q her max HP. Don't spend W on her first dash: Broken Wings is a flat 13s, so waiting for the full engage blocks the escape too.

edits.before: This is your window. Every time she dashes in, your W blocks the dash and your E into a wall stuns her out of her own combo before her stun lands. Your Q chunks her max-HP regardless of your gold, so even off cheap bruiser components you out-trade her. At 6 your R is a clean disengage or a displacement to body-block her reset — not burst, but it keeps you safe and denies her the kill. Bait the W out only when you're certain you can punish the next engage.
edits.after: This is your window. Every time she dashes in, your W stops it and your E into a wall stuns her out of her own combo before Ki Burst lands. Your Q chunks her max HP regardless of gold, so even off cheap components you out-trade her. At 6 your R punts her out of a reset — but it is a channel, and Ki Burst on 11-7s cancels it outright, so open with the stun and finish with R rather than starting it in her face.

notes: No mirror existed, so these findings are first-hand. Unusually, the page's central claim is correct: Broken Wings and Valor are both dashes, so Steadfast Presence really does turn off Riven's engage and escape, and the advice to save W for the full commit rather than the first dash is right. What was missing is that Ki Burst cancels Keeper's Verdict — Poppy's 140s ultimate answered by a 7s point-blank stun — now written into the level-6 row, whys[4] and the don'ts. Chart flipped in three rows as one atomic paired group: the 2+ item row belongs to Riven, which the page's own whys[6] and spikes[3] already said. The full layer refers to Riven as 'him/his' in tradeGood, tradeBad, ahead, breakdown.feeding and several report entries; fixed where edited, the remainder needs a champion-wide sweep.
